status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment: Yes this is not supported. Mahout is still at Lucene 4.6.x and hence would not be compatible with Solr 6.0.

To add more context to the previous post, we tried moving to Lucene 4.10.x back in March 2015 but that completely broke the vectorization code in the legacy mapreduce and was failing all tests.

If u r willing to take a stab at this and upgrade to Lucene 6.1.x, please reach out on dev@ and we can talk there.
